# Reviewed generated Kotlin API shape. Generated by `just binding snapshot-update`.

data class AdapterSnapshot(
    var state: AdapterState,
    var scanAuthorization: AuthorizationState,
    var connectionAuthorization: AuthorizationState,
    var name: String?,
)

enum class AdapterState {
    UNKNOWN,
    UNAVAILABLE,
    POWERED_OFF,
    POWERED_ON,
}

data class AdvertisementObservation(
    var scanSessionId: ScanSessionId,
    var peripheralId: PeripheralId,
    var localName: String?,
    var advertisedServices: List<BluetoothUuid>,
    var manufacturerData: List<ManufacturerData>,
    var serviceData: List<ServiceData>,
    var rssi: Short?,
    var connectable: Boolean?,
)

enum class AndroidScanMode {
    LOW_POWER,
    BALANCED,
    LOW_LATENCY,
    OPPORTUNISTIC,
}

data class AndroidScanOptions(
    var scanMode: AndroidScanMode?,
    var phy: AndroidScanPhy?,
    /** * Scanner batch delay in milliseconds; 0 reports every result immediately. */ var reportDelayMs: UInt?,
    /** * Scan only legacy (non-extended) advertisements. */ var legacy: Boolean?,
)

enum class AndroidScanPhy {
    LE1M,
    LE2M,
    LE_CODED,
}

data class AssociateCompanionDeviceCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    /** * At least one service UUID; the platform chooser filters candidates on it. */ var serviceUuids: List<BluetoothUuid>,
    /** * Optional label the platform chooser shows for this request. */ var displayName: String?,
    /** * Optional platform companion-device profile,
    for example * android.app.role.COMPANION_DEVICE_WATCH. */ var deviceProfile: String?,
    /** * Whether the platform should deliver presence to the app's companion-device service. * * The host opts in because it grants the App a wake-up privilege; the library ships the * service but never asks for presence on its own. */ var notifyOnDeviceNearby: Boolean,
)

enum class AuthorizationState {
    NOT_REQUIRED,
    NOT_DETERMINED,
    DENIED,
    RESTRICTED,
    AUTHORIZED,
}

data class BackendCapabilities(
    var platform: Platform,
    var contractVersion: UInt,
    var supportsDuplicateScanResults: Boolean,
    var supportsConnectableFlag: Boolean,
    var supportsReadRssi: Boolean,
    var supportsRequiredNotification: Boolean,
    var supportsRequiredIndication: Boolean,
    var reportsActualNotificationMode: Boolean,
)

class BackendEventIngressHandle : BackendEventIngressHandleInterface

interface BackendEventIngressHandleInterface {
    fun push(event: BleEvent): EventIngressStatus
}

interface BleBackend {
    fun capabilities(): BackendCapabilities
    fun bindEventIngress(ingress: BackendEventIngressHandle)
    fun initialize(command: InitializeCommand)
    fun setAdapterEnabled(command: SetAdapterEnabledCommand)
    fun queryDevices(command: QueryDevicesCommand)
    fun associateCompanionDevice(command: AssociateCompanionDeviceCommand)
    fun startScan(command: StartScanCommand)
    fun stopScan(command: StopScanCommand)
    fun connect(command: ConnectCommand)
    fun disconnect(command: DisconnectCommand)
    fun discoverGatt(command: DiscoverGattCommand)
    fun readCharacteristic(command: ReadCharacteristicCommand)
    fun writeCharacteristic(command: WriteCharacteristicCommand)
    fun readDescriptor(command: ReadDescriptorCommand)
    fun writeDescriptor(command: WriteDescriptorCommand)
    fun setNotifications(command: SetNotificationsCommand)
    fun readRssi(command: ReadRssiCommand)
    fun mtu(command: MtuCommand)
    fun setConnectionPriority(command: SetConnectionPriorityCommand)
    fun createBond(command: CreateBondCommand)
    fun removeBond(command: RemoveBondCommand)
    fun refreshGattCache(command: RefreshGattCacheCommand)
    fun cancelOperation(request: CancelOperationRequest)
    fun dispose()
}

enum class BleErrorCategory {
    PERMISSION,
    ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE,
    INVALID_STATE,
    NOT_FOUND,
    TIMEOUT,
    CANCELLED,
    OPERATION_ABORTED,
    CONNECTION,
    GATT,
    PROTOCOL,
    NOT_SUPPORTED,
    BACKEND,
    INTERNAL,
}

sealed class BleEvent {
    AdapterSnapshotChanged(commandId: CommandId?, snapshot: AdapterSnapshot),
    ScanStarted(commandId: CommandId, scanId: ScanSessionId),
    AdvertisementObserved(advertisement: AdvertisementObservation),
    ScanStopped(scanId: ScanSessionId, result: ScanStopResult),
    ConnectionStateChanged(commandId: CommandId?, connectionId: ConnectionId, result: ConnectionStateResult),
    GattDiscovered(commandId: CommandId, database: GattDatabase),
    CharacteristicRead(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, value: ByteArray),
    CharacteristicWritten(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId),
    DescriptorRead(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, descriptorId: GattDescriptorId, value: ByteArray),
    DescriptorWritten(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, descriptorId: GattDescriptorId),
    NotificationStateChanged(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, subscriptionId: SubscriptionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, state: NotificationState),
    NotificationReceived(connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, subscriptionId: SubscriptionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, value: ByteArray),
    RssiRead(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, rssi: Short),
    MtuRead(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, info: MtuInfo),
    DevicesListed(commandId: CommandId, devices: List<DeviceRecord>),
    CompanionPresenceChanged(present: Boolean, key: String, localName: String?),
    BondStateChanged(commandId: CommandId?, connectionId: ConnectionId, state: BondState),
    CommandCompleted(commandId: CommandId, error: BleEventError?),
    BackendError(error: BleEventError),
}

data class BleEventError(
    var category: BleErrorCategory,
    var message: String,
    var platformDetails: PlatformErrorDetails?,
)

sealed class BleHubException {
    BackendAssembly(detail: String),
    BackendCleanup(detail: String, platformDetails: PlatformErrorDetails?),
    ResourceBusy(detail: String),
    InvalidConfiguration(field: String, detail: String),
    FfiContract(detail: String),
}

data class BluetoothUuid(
    var value: String,
)

enum class BondState {
    NONE,
    BONDING,
    BONDED,
}

data class CancelOperationRequest(
    /** * Existing command identity; cancellation has no independent lifecycle. */ var targetCommandId: CommandId,
)

data class CharacteristicProperties(
    var readable: Boolean,
    var writableWithResponse: Boolean,
    var writableWithoutResponse: Boolean,
    var notifiable: Boolean,
    var indicatable: Boolean,
)

sealed class CommandDispatchException {
    Closed,
    InvalidRequest(detail: String),
    InvalidState(detail: String),
    OperationNotFound(targetCommandId: CommandId),
    OperationAlreadyCompleted(targetCommandId: CommandId),
    OperationNotCancellable(targetCommandId: CommandId),
    ResourceExhausted(detail: String),
    BackendUnavailable(detail: String, platformDetails: PlatformErrorDetails?),
    NotSupported(detail: String),
    FfiContract(detail: String),
}

data class CommandId(
    var value: ULong,
)

enum class CommandKind {
    INITIALIZE,
    SET_ADAPTER_ENABLED,
    QUERY_DEVICES,
    ASSOCIATE_COMPANION_DEVICE,
    START_SCAN,
    STOP_SCAN,
    CONNECT,
    DISCONNECT,
    DISCOVER_GATT,
    READ_CHARACTERISTIC,
    WRITE_CHARACTERISTIC,
    READ_DESCRIPTOR,
    WRITE_DESCRIPTOR,
    SET_NOTIFICATIONS,
    READ_RSSI,
    MTU,
    SET_CONNECTION_PRIORITY,
    CREATE_BOND,
    REMOVE_BOND,
    REFRESH_GATT_CACHE,
}

data class ConnectCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var peripheralId: PeripheralId,
    /** * Ask the platform to establish the link whenever the peer becomes available,
    instead of a * one-shot connect attempt. Where the platform cannot express this,
    the backend rejects the * command with CommandDispatchError::NotSupported rather than silently connecting once. */ var autoConnect: Boolean,
)

data class ConnectionId(
    var value: ULong,
)

enum class ConnectionPriority {
    BALANCED,
    HIGH,
    LOW_POWER,
}

enum class ConnectionState {
    CONNECTING,
    CONNECTED,
    DISCONNECTING,
    DISCONNECTED,
}

sealed class ConnectionStateResult {
    Ok(state: ConnectionState),
    Err(error: BleEventError),
}

data class CreateBondCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var pin: String?,
)

enum class DeviceQueryKind {
    CONNECTED,
    BONDED,
    COMPANION,
}

data class DeviceRecord(
    /** * Opaque and owner-scoped. Comparable with peripheral.key() when the same peer was scanned,
    * but it cannot address native state on its own. */ var key: String,
    var localName: String?,
    var connected: Boolean,
    var bonded: Boolean,
)

data class DisconnectCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
)

data class DiscoverGattCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var gattSessionId: GattSessionId,
)

sealed class EventIngressStatus {
    Delivered,
    Closed,
    InvalidEvent(message: String),
    DownstreamFailed(message: String),
}

sealed class EventSinkException {
    Rejected(detail: String),
    UnexpectedCallback(detail: String),
}

    var id: GattCharacteristicId,

    var properties: CharacteristicProperties,
    var descriptors: List<GattDescriptor>,
)

    var value: ULong,
)

    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var gattSessionId: GattSessionId,
    var services: List<GattService>,
)

    var id: GattDescriptorId,
    var uuid: BluetoothUuid,

    var value: ULong,

    var id: GattServiceId,

    var commandId: CommandId,
)

    var companyId: UShort,
    var payload: ByteArray,
)

    var companyId: UShort,
    var data: ByteArray,
    var mask: ByteArray?,
)

    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var request: UShort?,
)

data class MtuInfo(
    var mtu: UShort?,
    var maximumWriteWithResponse: UShort?,
    var maximumWriteWithoutResponse: UShort?,
)

sealed class NotificationAction {
    Enable(mode: NotificationModeRequest),
    Disable,
}

enum class NotificationMode {
    NOTIFICATION,
    INDICATION,
}

enum class NotificationModeRequest {
    PLATFORM_DEFAULT,
    REQUIRE_NOTIFICATION,
    REQUIRE_INDICATION,
}

sealed class NotificationState {
    Enabled(actualMode: NotificationMode?),
    Disabled,
}

data class PeripheralId(
    var value: ULong,
)

enum class Platform {
    WINDOWS,
    ANDROID,
    APPLE,
    LINUX,
    TEST,
}

data class PlatformErrorDetails(
    var platform: Platform,
    var code: String?,
    var name: String?,
    var message: String?,
    /** * Numeric platform status when the platform reports one. */ var status: Int?,
    /** * Bluetooth ATT error code when the failure came from an ATT response. */ var attCode: Int?,
)

data class QueryDevicesCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var kind: DeviceQueryKind,
    var serviceUuids: List<BluetoothUuid>,
)

    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var gattSessionId: GattSessionId,
    var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId,
)

    var commandId: CommandId,

)

    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
)

    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,

    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
)

data class ScanOptions(
    var serviceUuids: List<BluetoothUuid>,
    var namePrefix: String?,
    /** * Require an exact local-name match. Applied on both platforms by the scan predicate. */ var exactName: String?,
    var companyId: UShort?,
    /** * Require an advertisement RSSI at or above this value. Absent RSSI never matches. */ var minRssi: Short?,
    /** * Require a manufacturer-data payload match (prefix, or masked equality when mask is set). */ var manufacturerData: ManufacturerDataFilter?,
    /** * Android-only scanner tuning; None keeps the engine's fixed defaults. Apple rejects it. */ var android: AndroidScanOptions?,
    var allowDuplicates: Boolean,
)

data class ScanSessionId(
    var value: ULong,
)

sealed class ScanStopReason {
    Requested(commandId: CommandId),
    SystemSuspended,
}

sealed class ScanStopResult {
    Ok(reason: ScanStopReason),
    Err(error: BleEventError),
}

data class ServiceData(
    var serviceUuid: BluetoothUuid,
    var payload: ByteArray,
)

data class SetAdapterEnabledCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var enabled: Boolean,
)

data class SetConnectionPriorityCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var priority: ConnectionPriority,
)

data class SetNotificationsCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var gattSessionId: GattSessionId,
    var subscriptionId: SubscriptionId,
    var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId,
    var action: NotificationAction,
)

data class StartScanCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var scanSessionId: ScanSessionId,
    var options: ScanOptions,
)

data class StopScanCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var scanSessionId: ScanSessionId,
)

data class SubscriptionId(
    var value: ULong,
)

data class WriteCharacteristicCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var gattSessionId: GattSessionId,
    var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId,
    var value: ByteArray,
    var writeType: WriteType,
)

data class WriteDescriptorCommand(
    var commandId: CommandId,
    var connectionId: ConnectionId,
    var gattSessionId: GattSessionId,
    var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId,
    var descriptorId: GattDescriptorId,
    var value: ByteArray,
)

enum class WriteType {
    WITH_RESPONSE,
    WITHOUT_RESPONSE,
}
